hook: A $12 thermometer reads your turkey in 2 seconds.

scenes.visual_prompt: Oven door held open too long with heat visibly escaping, someone cutting into a turkey breast to check doneness out of frustration.
scenes.voiceover: The most common Thanksgiving failure isn't the sides — it's a turkey pulled too early or too late.

scenes.visual_prompt: Product graphic of the Alpha Grillers digital thermometer with overlay text '$12.31 · 4.8 stars · 91,526 ratings'.
scenes.on_screen_text: The highest star rating on this list.
scenes.voiceover: At $12.31, this thermometer has a 4.8-star average across 91,526 ratings — higher than every other tool I checked.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of the foldable probe inserting into a turkey breast, digital readout number climbing and then locking almost instantly.
scenes.voiceover: It's listed as a 1-2 second read, which is the actual requirement for checking a 15-pound bird fast.

scenes.visual_prompt: Graphic overlay of '165°F' stamped on a turkey breast and thigh diagram, USDA guidance text beneath it.
scenes.voiceover: USDA guidance calls for 165 degrees in the thickest part of the breast and thigh — the margin for error is narrow.

scenes.visual_prompt: An old dial thermometer stuck mid-read for several seconds while the oven door stays open, heat visibly shimmering out.
scenes.voiceover: Older dial models take 15 to 20 seconds to stabilize — that's heat lost every time you check.

scenes.visual_prompt: The thermometer's probe folding flat for storage, backlit display glowing in a dim kitchen at night.
scenes.voiceover: Reviewers say the backlit display and foldable probe hold up year after year, not just one season.

scenes.visual_prompt: Closing roundup card with all five compared products thumbnailed and a blog icon with 'link in bio'.
scenes.voiceover: This is one of five tools I checked against what Thanksgiving actually requires — full breakdown's on the blog.

caption: The highest-rated tool on my entire Thanksgiving prep list isn't the chopper — it's this $12.31 thermometer with a 4.8-star average across 91,526 ratings. A 1-2 second read is the difference between a turkey pulled at the right moment and one guessed at. Full comparison on the blog (link in bio).
